title: Roles
subtitle: Define custom roles that bundle workspace permissions. Assign them to members from the Members page.
builtinLegend: 4 built-in roles available: Owner · Admin · Member · Readonly. They cover most workspaces — custom roles are for least-privilege requirements.

empty.title: No custom roles yet
empty.body: Custom roles let you grant a precise bundle of permissions to a job function — for example, an on-call engineer who can purge queues on staging but not production.

gate.title: Custom Roles + Resource Scopes
gate.body: Define named permission bundles scoped to specific servers or environments. Available on the Enterprise plan.

planDowngradeBanner.title: Custom roles are read-only on this plan
planDowngradeBanner.body: Re-upgrade to Enterprise to edit. Existing assignments remain in effect; mutations are blocked at the API layer.

editor.descriptionHelper: Optional · what this role is for
editor.permissionsHelper: Pick the actions this role can perform. Optionally restrict each to specific servers or environments.

scope.anyAria: No scope restriction — applies to every server in the workspace
scope.environmentsPlaceholder: Type an environment and press Enter
scope.environmentsHelper: Free-text tags. Must match the `environment` field on a server exactly.

conflict.title: Role was modified elsewhere
conflict.body: Someone updated this role since you opened it. Reload to see the latest, or overwrite their changes.

escalation.tooltip: Your role doesn't currently hold {{permission}} at this scope. You can only grant permissions you yourself hold.

editor.nameTooShort: Name must be at least 2 characters
editor.nameReserved: That name is reserved for a built-in role
editor.duplicate: Permission already added with this scope
